1.why: The UI uses a clean sans-serif typeface with adequate letter and line spacing across headings, body text, and form labels.

2.why: Instructions use sentence case without italics or all-caps, and text is broken into short paragraphs rather than dense blocks.

3.why: Layouts are single-column, responsive, and fully readable at mobile width with no horizontal overflow or cramped elements.

4.why: Most instructions are brief and in plain language (e.g., 'Verify your identity', 'Store these recovery codes somewhere secure').

5.why: Demo credentials and a recovery-code placeholder (ABCD-EFGH-JKLM) give some format hints, but no example is shown for OTP/authenticator code entry.

6.why: Each step shows only a short instruction block; the user is never forced to scroll through a long text passage to proceed.

7.why: Manual secret and recovery codes are rendered as selectable text that can be copied, yet no explicit copy button is provided.

8.why: No QR code or scannable alternative appears; only a manual secret string and an otpauth:// URI text are offered.

9.why: Standard input fields may allow browser autofill, but no autocomplete attributes or password-manager affordances are visible.

10.why: Page title and primary green call-to-action button clearly indicate the current step and main action on each screen.

11.why: Screens generally present one primary task (sign in, verify, create secret, enter code) with a single prominent button.

12.why: Success feedback such as 'MFA is enabled' is clear, but many failures only repeat 'Unable to continue sign-in' without stating what comes next.

13.why: Users can regenerate recovery codes and retry entry, yet repeated failed sign-ins accumulate errors with no clear penalty-free restart path.

14.why: Error messages are either technical DOM exceptions or generic 'Unable to continue sign-in' text that neither explain the problem nor how to fix it.

15.why: No countdown timers or expiration warnings are shown on reading or code-entry screens, giving generous time to act.
